strategy: Use the Withering Fist-to-Stinger combo to spread poison then detonate it for massive AoE damage. Maintain survivability through built-in healing and armor scaling, adjusting difficulty dynamically to keep clear speed fast while progressing through War Plans activities (Helltide, Pit, Undercity) toward and past level 70.

paragon.note: Start on Menagerist; switch to Ritual around 210 Paragon points spent. Talon swaps for Fitness, and Fulminate for Colossal, in the midgame variant. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
